scope: Historical frozen 468-patient/2978-ROI complete five-fold OOF audit; no new model, selection, resampling or inferential test.

selection_independence.per_model_train_validation_outer_test_pa: Verified within archived role design and actual DeiT train/validation manifests; original aligned probability/checkpoint provenance retained.
selection_independence.reason: Historical common fusion-grid development used inner-validation information across cyclic folds; the same patients can be outer-test cases for another model. Prolonged same-cohort development and single-seed uncertainty remain.

definitions.fold_mean_sd: Unweighted arithmetic mean across five complete outer folds; sample SD uses ddof=1. These are not pooled OOF metrics or uncertainty intervals.
definitions.pooled_OOF: All 2978 ROIs, with each patient in exactly one outer fold; per-ROI weighting.
definitions.zero_division_policy: Precision/F1 undefined through zero predicted support use zero, consistently with original metric implementation; all four reference classes occur in each fold.
definitions.MAE: Mean absolute distance between numerical grade labels 0,1,2,3; does not assert equal clinical distance.
definitions.probability_normalization: For probability scoring only, each archived or exactly forward-fused row divided by its probability mass. Rows must be finite, nonnegative and sum within absolute tolerance 1e-4 of 1; hard argmax classes remain byte-aligned to frozen decisions.
definitions.multiclass_Brier: Mean over ROIs of sum of squared probability errors across all four classes; not divided by 4.
definitions.log_loss: Natural-log multiclass loss with float64 machine-epsilon clipping; independently checked against sklearn.log_loss.
definitions.ECE: Top-label confidence calibration error, 10 equal-width intervals [0,.1),...,[.9,1]; bin accuracy vs mean confidence, weighted by ROI count. Descriptive, not calibration or clinical utility proof.
definitions.targeted_errors: Normal-to-mild denominator true normal; mild-to-normal denominator true mild; moderate correct is moderate recall; severe underestimated means predicted grade<3; severe predicted normal/mild means grade<=1. Full 2x4 outcome counts for true normal and mild retain predictions into other grades.
